content: We promise according to our hopes, and perform according to our fears.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Courage is rarely the thunderous heroics we see in movies; it is the quiet voice at the end of the day that says, 'I will try again tomorrow.' When we wait to feel completely fearless before taking a step, we stay trapped in place.

Across his life and work, François de La Rochefoucauld saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Real strength shows up with a racing pulse and trembling hands. It is the willingness to be vulnerable, to risk looking foolish, and to stand up for what matters even when everything in you wants to hide.
reflectionPrompt: How can acknowledging your vulnerability help you build deeper self-trust and inner peace?
